subject: 城门守舍
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Geometry correction of this guardhouse game sprite. Keep the long porch, Song timber/plaster, grey roof, sunlight upper-left, materials unchanged. The right short ground edge is wrongly too shallow. REBUILD entire right side plane to a STEEPER upward-right angle, exact slope -0.5 rather than -0.41. Specifically ground left(234,540), front(858,852), right(1292,635): move current right ground corner UP about45px, keep left and front fixed. Reproject whole short side, roof and all rightward parallel horizontal beams to match this new axis. Long lower-left edge slope+0.5. Floor footprint must be7 wide x5 deep, horizontal front-edge/side-edge=1.4. Render exact orthographic yaw45 pitch30 2:1 diamond tile camera, parallel both axes, no perspective. Ground stone base thin, no thick pedestal. Full complete building with empty10% transparent margins all around; true transparent RGBA, no background, no halo, no writing/people/watermark, no guide lines. It is crucial to change the roof and building 3D geometry, not just add padding.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: 本轮未获审批候选，投影/材质参考

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 第2次运行返修：内置image_gen真实重出主体；逐张view_image及64×32占地叠图，宽深关系和两轴目视协调，左上光、暖灰瓦木石、宋意象，无文字人物现代物；无裁切。严格几何数值见geometry_qa；不将轻微告警当成已通过。
